account.badgeMockModeDesc: VITE_KLQ_CHECKOUT_URL is not configured, all buy buttons fall back to email. Set this env var to switch to Waffo / Lemon Squeezy online payment.
account.buySteps: Your license key is emailed to you after purchase. Come back here and paste it to activate.
account.checkoutNotConfigured: Set VITE_KLQ_CHECKOUT_URL at build time (your own Lemon Squeezy checkout) to enable.
account.configServerHint: Three more take effect only server-side and cannot be detected from the app — set them as Cloudflare Pages environment variables:
account.copyFail: Copy failed — please write the key down manually
account.excludedAi: Not included: AI service costs. AI actions use your own OpenAI / DeepSeek account and are billed by that provider.
account.excludedTax: Not included: taxes and exchange-rate differences — the checkout page shows the final amount.
account.faqAiCostA: Kliq itself charges nothing for AI usage. Transcription and summaries use your own OpenAI / DeepSeek / Anthropic API key, billed directly by your AI provider (DeepSeek ~ 1/10 the cost of GPT-4).
account.faqLifetimeA: Pro is a yearly subscription with all updates included for one year. Lifetime is a one-time purchase — every future update, including AI engine upgrades, is included forever.
account.faqLifetimeQ: What is the difference between Pro and Lifetime?
account.faqProExpireA: After expiry, Kliq returns to Free (all basics + the AI modules you already activated at your Pro purchase price). Renew Pro, or upgrade to Lifetime to lock in forever-licence rights.
account.faqProExpireQ: What happens when my Pro subscription expires?
account.faqRefundA: 30-day no-questions-asked refund for both Pro and Lifetime, see the refund policy page. Lifetime refund requests beyond 6 months of use are typically denied.
account.faqTeamA: A single-user license activates on one machine at a time (you can transfer it via the Account Center). For team volume licensing, contact sales.
account.faqTeamQ: Can my company / team use it?
account.flowStepDesc: Follow the steps; AI handles the rest
account.includedLicense: Included: a lifetime licence for Kliq Pro.
